faqs.q: How does IELTS Ultimate calculate Reading and Listening Band Scores?
faqs.a: Scores out of 40 follow official IELTS Academic conversion thresholds (e.g., 30/40 = Band 7.0, 35/40 = Band 8.0) and round overall four-skill averages to the nearest 0.5 band.

faqs.q: Are Writing and Speaking evaluations connected to a live AI service?
faqs.a: Currently, Writing and Speaking results use realistic local demo rubric templates stored in JSON so you can test the complete submission, timer, recording, and feedback workflow offline without external API keys.

faqs.q: Are my test answers and study progress saved?
faqs.a: Yes! Active drafts, completed study plan tasks, bookmarks, community likes/comments, and completed test attempts persist automatically in your browser's LocalStorage.

faqs.q: Can I switch between Academic and General Training tracks?
faqs.a: Yes. Both Full Mock Test and Reading/Writing libraries allow switching tracks, and you can set your default target track in My Profile.
